title: Geppy Brand • Emotes & Expressions Pack
anchor_prompt:
[SOT Character Anchor - Preserve facial likeness, suit design, and character identity] | The tone and style of Geppy AI (founded by Jon Gephart of Gephart's Tech Consulting) is rooted in a Saturday-morning cartoon, approachable, and dependable vibe—embodying the ultimate friendly IT guy who is always there to help and teach.

Key characteristics of Geppy's tone and style include:

Approachable and Patient: Rather than relying on cold, highly technical jargon, Geppy breaks down IT problems so they are easy for everyday people to understand, focusing heavily on teaching and helping rather than just fixing behind the scenes.

Upbeat and Energetic: Inspired by classic, adventurous animation styles (like Duck Tales), the persona is enthusiastic, proactive, and ready to tackle any gadget glitch with a positive attitude.

Reliable and 24/7: Positioned as a dependable, around-the-clock technical support specialist who bridges the gap between automated AI assistance and human backup (backed by Gephart's Tech Consulting).

Visually Consistent: Defined by clean, friendly branding—such as his signature plain blue shirt featuring the white "Geppy" text—paired with a hard-G pronunciation (like "Go" or "Ghost") to keep his identity grounded, clear, and distinct. | Primary Image Anchor: /api/sot/reference-file/1791929177_Geppy.png | Reference Gallery: 2 contextual reference images
